notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The county Elections page lists, per election, 'Unofficial Precinct Results' and 'Unofficial Cumulative Results' PDFs (text PDFs from the tabulation system, with Absentee, Early and Election Day columns per precinct) plus official precinct, cumulative and canvass reports. The server gives each file its own Last-Modified (not the request time), so upload times are usable; a file replaced later would hide an earlier upload. 2024 general: precinct report printed 'Run Time 7:39 PM Run Date 11/05/2024' (PDF ModDate 6 Nov 2024 02:01 UTC = 8:01 PM CST) but Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 13:25:31 GMT = 7:25 AM CST Nov 6, after election night; the county-total report has Last-Modified 13:26:01 GMT. 2026 primary: precinct report printed 'Run Time 8:47 PM Run Date 03/03/2026', Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 06:41:37 GMT = 12:41 AM CST, on election night; its precinct numbers equal the official precinct report (e.g. precinct 1 Jasmine Crockett 4 / 40 / 29 / 73). 2026 runoff: precinct report printed 'Run Time 7:16 PM Run Date 05/26/2026', Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 18:23:42 GMT = 1:23 PM CDT May 27, after election night; numbers equal the official precinct report. Check 3 (Wayback) pending: origin/wayback-data not present, so earlier election-night uploads that were later replaced cannot be ruled out for 2024 and the runoff. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2024_general LATER to UNDETERMINED; 2026_runoff LATER to UNDETERMINED. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary END, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. Exactly one election is determined, so the rule gives PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT with confidence low. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.) Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.
